description: This header file declares an API for monitoring changes to the current working directory. It provides functions for registering and unregistering callbacks, reparenting relative paths, and notifying changes when the directory is changed. It is used to implement a notification mechanism for directory changes within a Git-related codebase.

methods.name: chdir_notify_register
methods.description: Registers a callback to be notified when the working directory changes.

methods.name: chdir_notify
methods.description: Changes the working directory to a new path and notifies all registered callbacks.

methods.name: reparent_relative_path
methods.description: Reparents a relative path from one root directory to another, returning a new allocated path string.

ctags.name: chdir_notify_callback
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(const char * name,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd,void * data)
